identification.name: Aluminum AlSi10Mg (LPBF, As-Built)
identification.common_form_notes: Supplied as gas-atomised spherical powder for laser powder bed fusion (L-PBF / DMLS / SLM). Not available as conventional wrought stock; this alloy is specifically formulated for AM.
identification.notes: AlSi10Mg is the standard aluminium alloy for laser powder bed fusion (L-PBF). The high silicon content (~10%) suppresses hot cracking during rapid solidification — the primary reason conventional alloys such as 6061 and 7075 are nearly unprintable by DMLS. Properties given are as-built (no post-processing). Stress relief (2 h at 300–350 °C) significantly reduces UTS (~280 MPa) and yield (~160 MPa) but roughly doubles elongation and partially restores thermal conductivity (~170 W/m·K). EOS AM-optimised T6 (530 °C/30 min water quench + 165 °C/6 h) recovers yield strength to 250–300 MPa with improved ductility. As-built parts are anisotropic: Young's modulus 70–75 GPa, yield 240–270 MPa, elongation 6–9% depending on build orientation (XY vs Z); anisotropy is largely eliminated by heat treatment. Thermal conductivity as-built (~103 W/m·K, XY) is ~40% lower than cast AlSi10Mg due to the as-solidified microstructure; heat treatment restores it significantly. Strength degrades above ~150 °C for long-term service and falls sharply above 250 °C. Shear strength derived from von Mises criterion: UTS/√3 = 460/√3 ≈ 266 MPa. Thermal diffusivity derived from k, ρ, Cp.

typical_usage: Aerospace brackets and housings, automotive heat exchangers, complex internal-channel cooling structures, lightweight structural parts, and tooling inserts where the geometric freedom of metal AM is required with aluminium's density and thermal conductivity.
